task.description:
This is a FOCUSED RE-CHECK, not a full re-validation. Your prior pass FAILed this same amendment because sub-case (a) (under section 2's new 'YAML comment-line/sequence-item' shape) stated the marker precedes the `id:` line for the REQ-021 example, citing `docs/requirements.yaml:807-809` -- but the actual applied marker sits between id: (806) and title: (808), i.e. immediately above title:, not id:. CODE-DESIGNER has now corrected only that clause (see step-02 handoff's result.before/result.after for the exact text change) and touched nothing else in the file.

Your job: verify (1) the REQ-021 citation in sub-case (a) now accurately matches the real file content -- read docs/requirements.yaml lines 805-809 yourself and confirm id: at 806, marker at 807, title: at 808, and confirm the design doc's wording states the marker precedes title:, not id:; and (2) that nothing else in the document changed since your prior FAIL verdict -- diff the current file against what you reviewed before (or use `git show a5af4627 -- lib/letflow/design/req237-zig-provenance-marking-convention.md` / `git log -p` on the file) and confirm section 1, sections 4-8, the top-of-file chunking amendment, sub-case (b), and the REQ-017 example are byte-identical to what you already passed judgment on previously (whichever of those you had already found acceptable).

Do not re-review the whole document from scratch as if this were a first pass -- scope your re-check to exactly these two questions. If both check out, PASS. If the citation is still wrong, or if anything beyond the sub-case (a) clause changed, FAIL with specifics.
acceptance_criteria: REQ-021 example accurately states the marker precedes title: (not id:), matching docs/requirements.yaml:806-808 verified directly
The citation cites the precise lines (806/807/808) rather than a vague or incorrect range
No other part of the document changed beyond this one clause since the prior FAIL

requirements_yaml_806_808.808: title: Wire identity into the Plug request pipeline (auth.zig/tenant_status.zig equivalent)

verified.design_doc_clause: Sub-case (a) now reads: 'REQ-021: id: at docs/requirements.yaml:806, marker at line 807, title: at line 808 -- the marker precedes the title: line' -- matches the file exactly, with precise line numbers rather than a vague range.
verified.diff_scope: git show a5af4627 -- lib/letflow/design/req237-zig-provenance-marking-convention.md shows only the sub-case (a) REQ-021 clause text was rewritten (old text claimed marker precedes id: citing 807-809; new text correctly states marker precedes title: citing 806/807/808). No other hunk touches sub-case (b), the REQ-017 example, section 1, sections 4-8, or the top-of-file chunking amendment paragraph structure -- those are unchanged by this commit.

result.findings: All three acceptance criteria satisfied: (1) REQ-021 clause now accurately states marker precedes title:, verified directly against docs/requirements.yaml lines 806-808; (2) citation cites precise lines 806/807/808; (3) commit a5af4627 is scoped to only this one clause -- no other content changed.
